title: Canonical completed-ring strict open exchange
statement: For an adic datum $(A,I)$ as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and an open Cartesian square $s$ as in [def-cbc-open-immersion-square], write $E_j$ for sheafified module extension, constructed from [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] and [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], over the actual completed rings $A_T$. Define $J_j$ by applying $E_j$ at every strict tower index and deriving this exact functor, and likewise for $j'$. Let $G_g,G_{g_U}$ be the total derived levelwise module pullbacks of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Define the simultaneous inverse strict diagram map by applying the ordinary completed-ring inverse open exchange at every index, with its ordinary sectionwise Cartesian right-adjoint normalization. Define $\beta:G_g\circ J_j\simeq J_{j'}\circ G_{g_U}$ as the unique derived natural isomorphism characterized on every objectwise K-flat strict tower complex $P$ by the equation: $\beta^{-1}_{QP}$ followed by the source model map equals the target model map followed by the image of the strict inverse map under localization. Here $\gamma$ is that fixed simultaneous inverse strict map, and the two model maps are the composites of the exact-extension factor and the actual universal pullback counit, in the indicated source and target orders. On reduction towers define the reduced exchange by precomposition with the actual completed reduction functor. No completed ring-map invertibility, quasi-compactness, completeness, constructibility or boundedness is imposed.
